title: After homicide ruling, Boston councilor wants officers involved in South Bay jail death placed on leave
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Boston Councilor Miniard Culpepper urges leave for officers linked to Shacoby Kenny's homicide at South Bay jail.
State medical examiner ruled Shacoby Kenny's December 2025 death a homicide from brain condition caused by lack of blood and oxygen.
Culpepper proposes resolution for officers' leave; calls for independent investigation into in-custody deaths and promotes witness protection.

title: Norwood Hospital moves closer to being acquired through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Massachusetts Senate approves bill to seize Norwood Hospital property through eminent domain for nonprofit ownership.
Norwood Hospital closed since 2020 after flood; construction halted due to Steward Health Care's 2024 bankruptcy.
New bill permits state to transfer property to a nonprofit or lease it for up to 99 years if no sale by 2033.

title: Patriots rookie Eli Raridon is looking like a potential Day 1 contributor
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Eli Raridon is emerging as a potential contributor for the Patriots amid tight-end competition.
Patriots' backup tight end role opened for Raridon after Julian Hill's season-ending injury.
Head coach Mike Vrabel encourages Raridon to play fast, aiding in his development this preseason.

title: Were they dishonest with me at the quick lube shop?
author: John Paul
bullets: Quick lube shop recommended unnecessary filter changes, likely based on incomplete service history in their system.
European cars like a Mercedes C 300 may require brake fluid changes every three years to prevent corrosion.
Subaru Forester owners with power liftgates may face issues with battery drain due to faulty release switches or weak battery.

title: Abington police officer placed on leave after chase of stolen car ends in crash that killed 17-year-old boy
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Abington officer on leave after a stolen SUV chase resulted in a crash, killing 17-year-old Sebastian Hamilton.
The crash at 877 Washington St. hospitalized four teenage passengers; one seriously injured girl was ejected from the SUV.
The 2019 Hyundai Santa Fe was reported stolen in Brockton; the officer's leave is standard procedure, not punitive.

title: Madden 27 Ratings: Christian Gonzalez is NFL’s top-ranked CB in new game
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Christian Gonzalez is the highest-ranked cornerback in Madden 27 with a 98 overall rating.
Six players, including Josh Allen and Ja'Marr Chase, received a perfect 99 overall rating in Madden 27.
Madden 27 will officially release on August 13, with early access available starting August 6.

title: Jeff Passan floats blockbuster trade for Red Sox and Marlins
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jeff Passan suggests Red Sox target Otto Lopez and Liam Hicks from Marlins before MLB trade deadline.
Red Sox seek upgrades at shortstop, catcher, and bullpen, with Lopez and Hicks providing immediate improvements.
Lopez excels with a .329 batting average and strong defense, while Hicks offers power with 14 home runs in 2026.

title: Death of woman, 18, found dead in Mattapan home owned by Pressley’s husband ruled a homicide
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Yoseliani Ann Marte Ocasio, 18, was found dead from a gunshot wound at a Mattapan home owned by Conan Harris.
The Medical Examiner ruled Ocasio's death a homicide; Boston Police have made no arrests or charges as of Thursday.
Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley, whose husband owns the property, said Ocasio's death highlights the issue of domestic violence.

title: Caleb Lomu is learning more than just right tackle at his first training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Caleb Lomu, a first-round pick, plays mainly right tackle but is learning multiple positions at Patriots training camp.
Coach Mike Vrabel praises Lomu's versatility, indicating potential to play anywhere on the offensive line except center.
Lomu feels comfortable at right tackle yet values learning other positions to secure a role on the team.

title: Kayshon Boutte addresses trade rumors, future with Patriots
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Kayshon Boutte, Patriots receiver, addresses trade rumors, stating his focus remains on the current season with New England.
Patriots' coach Mike Vrabel confirms willingness to trade receivers due to crowded wide receiver roster.
Boutte, entering a contract year, remains one of the standout performers at Patriots' training camp so far.
